about: A kept string is one the design leaves as it is because it already follows the guide (the `Kept as is` list of each page, and a kept row). check-copy.mjs (H17) runs the lints of a new string over every one: a statement that something could not be done (D2), an alternation of forms (D6), a count with a plural noun and no singular (C4), the marks and terms of C5 and C6, and the person of C8 (no we, our or I). A kept string that trips one is either fixed (it becomes a row) or listed here with the lint and the reason it is right.

exempt.why: a filter option and a status name: it names the category of emails whose sending failed and asks nothing of the reader; the details dialog carries the message
a label the reader speaks, in their own voice: C8's stated exception (as "I've copied the secret", A-08.32)

exempt.text: The registration secret cannot be viewed or changed. To issue a new secret, delete this entry and create a new one.
exempt.why: a helper that states a standing limitation and gives its way out in the next sentence; nothing has failed, so it is not an error row

exempt.text: API tokens are used to authenticate webhook requests. The token value is only shown once during creation and cannot be retrieved later.
exempt.why: a helper that states a standing limitation (a token's value is shown once); nothing has failed, so it is not an error row
a bullet-separated line: each part starts with a capital, like the chips beside it (the first part is the role's label, A-04.69); the two forms of "class" come from the source's own count
